Definition: from G5571 and G5547; a spurious Messiah:--false Christ.
BiblicalUsage: Pseudochristos means a false Christ, a spurious Messiah. Jesus warned that there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders, insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the warning is in the wonders: the false Christ does not come empty-handed, he comes with signs, and only those who know the true Christ will not be deceived.
